$comment: mare RPC protocol — JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line on stdin/stdout (mare --rpc)

envelope.title: Message
envelope.description:
Any incoming line: request (method + id), notification (method, no id) or response (id +
result/error). An error response always carries `id`, `null` when the request's id could not
be read (JSON-RPC 2.0 §5).

MethodInfo.description: One contract method as callers see it (the runtime catalog, like `nvim_get_api_info`).

expose.description: Contract visibility (`both`; only remotely callable methods are listed).

access.description:
`primary` (never grantable to a peer), `peer` (grantable by `peer.allow`), or
`peer_default` (open to peers without listing in `peer.allow`).

scope.description: `host`, `workspace` or `session`; a session method takes a required `session_id`.

order.description: Positional Lua arguments; a trailing `...` is the opts table of the remaining ones.

registration.description: Lua gets a disposer; JSON callers get `{registration_id}` for `registrations.release`.

MethodExpose.description: Contract visibility for a service method.

oneOf.description: Callable from Lua plugins and over remote RPC.
Callable from Lua plugins only.

Default when omitted or unrecognized is [`MethodAccess::Primary`] (owner-only).

capabilities.description: Callbacks the host can answer. Undeclared callbacks are never sent (defaults apply).

approval_timeout_ms.description: Optional human approval timeout in milliseconds; absent means wait without a deadline.

params.title: OptionsGetParams
params.description: Read effective option values (matching `mare.o.<name>`). Sensitive fields (`config_sensitive`, `providers` keys/headers/query, credentials) are always redacted like `/config`.

keys.description: option names or dotted paths (default: all)

describe.description: return per-key metadata (`effective`, `default`, `source`, `description`, `redacted`, …) instead of bare values

result.title: EmptyResult
result.description: Empty object result for side-effect methods with no resource payload (`{}`).

params.title: ConfigDescribeParams
params.description: Return redacted config metadata, provenance, and redacted warnings.

keys.description: option names or dotted paths (default: all)

effective.description: effective value (redacted for sensitive fields; `null` when unset)

default.description: registered default value (redacted for sensitive fields), when defined

params.title: StateSnapshotRequest
params.description:
Read isolated durable application state (distinct from `agent.get`).
Absent or deleted namespaces report `exists: false` and `null` value with tombstone revision retained.

params.title: StateCompareExchangeRequest
params.description:
Atomically replace durable namespace state at `expected_revision` (`ok`, `conflict` with the current snapshot, or `rejected`).
Strict JSON preserves null and empty containers; deletion requires `null` and retains a monotonic revision. Cancellation before publication prevents writes; after publication admission rollback is not guaranteed, and `unknown_state` requires reread/reconciliation.

result.title: EmptyResult
result.description: Empty object result for side-effect methods with no resource payload (`{}`).

result.title: EventsListResult
result.description:
`events.list` result. Currently returns the built-in `protocol_events!` registry entries;
service contract `events` declarations are not supported yet.

EventMode.description: Dispatch mode declared for a protocol event.

EventScope.description: Execution scope of a registered event (`host`, `session`, or `turn`).

EventDelivery.description: Stream delivery class under consumer backpressure.

EventOnError.description: How listener errors are handled during dispatch.

params.title: EventsSubscribeParams
params.description: `events.subscribe`: subscribe to (or filter) a session's event stream.

session_id.description: session id to subscribe to (required unless `scope = "all"` is explicitly set by the owner)

session_epoch.description: last observed `session_epoch`; mismatches fall back to `mode = "baseline"`

last_seq.description: last delivered `seq` within `session_epoch` for resumptive replay

oneOf.description: Scoped to a single open session (`session_id` required).
Host-wide across sessions (primary connection only).

seq.description: sequence number at which the stream continues (`next_seq` for `live`/`baseline`, `last_seq + 1` for `replay`)

limit.description: Optional maximum number of items to return in one page (>= 1).

allowed.description: methods this connection may call (default set + the session's `peer.allow`)

params.title: PeerMessageParams
params.description:
`peer.message` params: a message from another session. Where the socket reports the
connecting process (Unix credentials), a `from` that disagrees with it is refused: a `pid`
other than the connecting process's, or the `name` of a registered session that isn't it.
Everything else in `from`, and `policy`, is self-reported: shown only, never grounds for
allowing anything. Always held until the receiving user confirms; a plugin can
take it over via the `peer/inbound` event. Never an approval.

queue_only.description: enqueue the message without waking an idle receiver

policy.description: the sender's policy as it reports it (display only until identities can be verified)

PeerRef.description:
The sender of a `peer.message` as it describes itself — shown to the receiving user (with
whether the session registry knows the name), never grounds for allowing anything.

status.description:
"held" (waiting for the receiving user; the outcome follows as `peer.message_status`) or
"handled" (a plugin took it over via `peer/inbound`)

supports_images.description: This consumer can display image data. Does not alter native terminal capabilities.

supports_artifact_images.description: This consumer resolves output-backed image references through the same connection.

callback.update.title: CallbackUpdateParams
callback.update.description:
`callback.update`: client → server notification streaming a partial update for an in-flight
`callback.call` request identified by `id`.

$/cancel_request.description: Cancels an outstanding mare-to-host request. Late replies to this ID are ignored.

event.title: EventParams
event.description: Envelope of an `event` notification: unified across RPC and headless streams.

session_epoch.description: opaque in-memory epoch identifier that rotates on every session create, load, or switch

turn_id.description: run (prompt) the event belongs to — matches `agent.prompt` `turn_id`

ignorable.description: whether a client that does not recognize this event type may skip it

AgentTerminationReason.description: Machine-readable final outcome; provider error text never controls this classification.

CancellationCause.description: Machine-readable origin of an interrupted turn (`termination_reason == "interrupted"`).

EventError.description: Structured error payload matching protocol component `error` (`{ code, message, data? }`).

lagged.title: Lagged
lagged.description: Sequence range omitted when an ordinary consumer cursor fell behind the bounded event log.

snapshot.title: BaselineSnapshotParams
snapshot.description:
`snapshot` notification (mare → host): emitted immediately after an `events.subscribe` reply
with `mode = "baseline"`, and immediately after `lagged` when a live cursor is evicted.

seq.description: Ring tail sequence number `S` at the moment of the non-yielding cut; following events start at `S + 1`.

parts.description: Baseline parts available to page via `baseline.read` (e.g. `["entries", "active_items"]`).

dropped.title: Dropped
dropped.description: Drop count for unretained `lossy` or refused events omitted from external stream consumers.

stream.failed.title: StreamFailedParams
stream.failed.description:
`event` notification params — exactly one `mare -p --json` line.
An event stream is incomplete and this connection will close.

disabled.description: Visible and searchable, but a conforming UI must not select this item.

node.description:
Existing Node description. Image bytes become bounded canonical base64 `data`; no paths,
callbacks, tokens, or userdata. Deserialize via mare.ui.node_from_wire in a Lua frontend.

expanded_node.description: Same Markdown document with each enhanced fence followed by its complete source.

peer.message_status.title: PeerMessageStatus
peer.message_status.description:
`peer.message_status` notification (mare → peer): the receiving user's decision on a held
message.

ui_image_resource.title: Descriptor
ui_image_resource.description:
Portable reference carried by UI image nodes. Native resolver identities never cross
the wire; receiving frontends explicitly rebind this descriptor to a local resolver.

ui_output_image_key.title: OutputImageKey
ui_output_image_key.description:
JSON payload of an image resource key in the built-in `output` namespace. The locator is
opaque and must be read on the originating RPC connection; these facts grant no access.

params.title: CallbackCallParams
params.description:
`callback.call`: server → client request invoking one contract callback on a registration the
client holds. Arguments match the callback's params schema; result is
checked against its result schema.

params.title: ApprovalRequestParams
params.description:
`approval.request` (mare → host): a tool call or a network host needs approval.
No answer (timeout, disconnect, error, invalid result) counts as `deny`.

approval_id.description: unique approval lifecycle id (pairs with `approval/requested` and `approval/resolved`)

command.description: shell command, when the tool runs one

diff.description: proposed change (patch / edit), when the tool writes files

reason.description: why approval is needed (from the policy vote)

unconfined.description: runs outside the local sandbox (MCP / RPC-host tools)

proposed_amendment.description: a rule the policy proposes for `allow_amend` (opaque to core)

requested_permissions.description: Explicit permission increment requested by this tool call (read/write paths, network hosts).

scope.description: Requested maximum lifetime, when this is a structured permission request.

PermissionProfile.description:
Additional rights requested or granted by a scoped permission tool. Paths are native
absolute paths in callbacks; write roots must be existing physical directories.

permissions.description: Optional structured subset of the requested read/write/network increment.

scope.description: Lifetime of the grant: turn or session (the request remains an upper bound).

amendment.description: with `allow_amend`: the rule to persist (opaque to core)

reason.description: shown to the model when denied

PermissionProfile.description:
Additional rights requested or granted by a scoped permission tool. Paths are native
absolute paths in callbacks; write roots must be existing physical directories.

params.title: McpElicitationParams
params.description: `mcp.elicitation` (mare → host): an MCP server requested user input or URL confirmation.

body.description: Explanatory lines shown above the options (strings or wire `Node` objects).

multi.description: Allow checking multiple items before confirming.

disabled.description: Visible and searchable, but a conforming UI must not select this item.

result.title: UiSelectResult
result.description: 0-based index/tab, optional action key and filter text, or null index when cancelled/interrupted

selected_indices.description: 0-based checked item indices for a multi-select; an empty array is a valid answer.

result.title: UiTextPromptResult
result.description: Result of a text prompt dialog (`ui.input` / `ui.editor`).

confirmed.description: true/false when answered; null when cancelled or interrupted

result.title: UiTextPromptResult
result.description: Result of a text prompt dialog (`ui.input` / `ui.editor`).

parse_error.meaning: the message is not valid JSON

invalid_request.meaning: the message is not a valid request

method_not_found.meaning: no such method, or it is not exported to this caller

invalid_arguments.meaning: the arguments do not match the method's schema

already_provided.meaning: the service already has a provider

invalid_result.meaning: the provider's result does not match the method's schema

internal.meaning: an unexpected failure; the message is bounded and carries no raw error value

cancelled.meaning: cancelled by the caller, an owner release or a shutdown

inactive_ctx.meaning: the caller's context was disposed; it can no longer register anything

timed_out.meaning: a deadline passed before the work finished

disconnected.meaning: the connection that implements or awaits the call went away

denied.meaning: not allowed for the connection this work runs for

unavailable.meaning: the service or its provider is not available

stale_session.meaning: the session changed since the id was obtained

overloaded.meaning: admission refused before the work started; try again later

busy.meaning: the target cannot take the request now and it cannot be queued

unsupported.meaning: no backend or model supports the requested capability

unsupported_version.meaning: the protocol major version is not supported

request_id_conflict.meaning: a request id was reused with different content

invalid_namespace.meaning: the state namespace name is not valid

invalid_value.meaning: the state value is not valid

read_only.meaning: the state namespace is read-only here

lock_timeout.meaning: the state lock was not acquired in time

corrupt.meaning: the stored state cannot be read

revision_exhausted.meaning: the state revision counter is exhausted

io.meaning: the state could not be read or written

baseline.stale.meaning: the baseline handle is unknown, expired, superseded, completed, or from another session epoch

baseline.unknown_part.meaning: the requested baseline part is not valid for this baseline

baseline.item_too_large.meaning: a single baseline item exceeds the page byte budget
